propositions: newly added hard-fail CI gates break branches created before the gate definition, with no grandfather guard or if-present check
code-review criteria routing lacks a mechanism to gate project criteria on file-change globs, so applies_to has no effect on project.* criteria dispatch

the ci-gate-compat advisory criterion must ask whether a pipeline-config change introduces a required gate with no grandfather guard, phrased vendor-neutrally without hard-coded GitHub Actions references
project code-review criteria must be filtered by their applies_to globs against changed files in the review before dispatch
a new [code_review] ci_config_globs config key must allow projects to override the declared applies_to globs for any criterion that names applies_to_config_key

the eight CI vendor globs (.github/workflows, Jenkinsfile, .gitlab-ci.yml, .circleci/, azure-pipelines, .buildkite/, bitbucket-pipelines.yml, .drone.yml) must be declared in routing, not hard-coded in Python, to keep the verifier portable
